cases.prompt: 我是销售运营，请帮我梳理每周制作销售复盘报告的工作。
assertions: asks exactly one question per turn
uses no more than 15 main questions
follows up on vague actions and judgment
captures one normal path and one exception
labels unsupported employee statements as E3
asks the employee to correct the draft
includes a compact flowchart in the confirmed card
does not recommend AI, RPA, workflow, RAG, or Agent
does not claim cost savings or ROI

cases.prompt: 我是采购专员，紧急采购基本都在系统里处理，帮我梳理一下。
assertions: asks exactly one question per turn
uses neutral non-blaming language when the employee is defensive
decomposes vague statements such as all in the system and depends on the situation
discovers unofficial tracking only through evidence-oriented follow-up
does not label a personal spreadsheet as an official company system
separates E1 sample fields, E3 employee estimates, and E4 policy
lets the employee correct the draft before confirmation
does not recommend transformation technology or claim ROI
